editorial:
If you grew up loving Barbie movies, this one is a fun underwater adventure you will want to dive into. You follow Merliah, a talented surfer who discovers she is actually half mermaid. With her dolphin friend Zuma by her side, she travels to the magical kingdom of Oceana to rescue her mother, the queen, from an evil mermaid named Eris. The story mixes surfing culture with fantasy, giving you bright ocean scenes, catchy music, and a brave heroine who learns to believe in herself. It feels like a mix of a beach movie and a fairy tale, which makes it easy to enjoy with kids or on your own.

The animation is colorful and smooth for its time, and the voice acting keeps the characters lively and fun. The pacing moves quickly, so you never feel bored, though some jokes land better than others. The biggest strength is the positive message about family and courage, while the downside is that the story can feel a little predictable. If you have young kids or just want a light, feel-good watch, this is a great pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Merliah confronts Eris in a surfing showdown and uses her special powers to defeat her. She learns that her mother, Queen Calissa, has been trapped, and Merliah frees her. The twist is that Merliah chooses to keep her human life while also embracing her mermaid side, proving she can be both. The movie ends with Oceana safe, Merliah reunited with her mom, and everyone celebrating together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family-friendly fantasy adventures and Barbie movies.
